shared_elements: animal in profile rendered in low relief
relief carving on an upright slab/pillar with rounded or shaped top
figures placed on a broadly vertical field
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief figures on an upright slab, and both include a profile quadruped, but that is the extent of the correspondence. A shows one or two isolated, sparsely placed animals with no framing, while B is a densely packed, register-divided composition of human figures, a winged emblem and rows of sign-like symbols — an entirely different organising scheme and repertoire.
